---
title: "A Table Cell That Opens With a Parenthesis"
shorttitle: "Booktabs trim argument"
author:
  - name: Test Author
    affiliations:
      - name: Test University
keep-tex: true
format:
  apaquarto-pdf: default
---

<!--
Reproducer for issue #164. booktabs' rules take an optional trim argument,
written \midrule(rl), and look for it by peeking at the character that follows
the rule. A table whose first cell opens with a literal "(" -- the term name
"(Intercept)" that every model summary produces -- is read as the start of one,
and the build dies with

    ! Undefined control sequence.
    <argument> ...\else \global \expandafter \let \cmrsideswitch

Only the longtable form is affected, since the peek lives in booktabs'
\@BLTrule. Pandoc's own tables are out of reach of it, because pandoc writes
\noalign{} after every rule; a table written as latex puts the row hard against
the rule and does reach it. header.tex gives \@BLTrule an empty trim spec so
that it stops peeking.

Render from the tests directory:

    quarto render booktabs-paren-cell.qmd

A successful run produces a PDF with four tables, each showing its rules and
an "(Intercept)" row. Before the fix, cases 3 and 4 took the build down.
-->

```{r}
#| echo: false
d <- data.frame(term = c("(Intercept)", "x"), estimate = c(-1.5, 2.0))
```

# 1. A markdown table, which pandoc writes

```{r}
#| label: tbl-markdown
#| tbl-cap: "Written by pandoc, so every rule is followed by a noalign"
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(d)
```

# 2. A latex table with booktabs rules

```{r}
#| label: tbl-booktabs
#| tbl-cap: "Written as latex, in a tabular"
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(d, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE)
```

# 3. A latex table with booktabs rules in a longtable

```{r}
#| label: tbl-longtable
#| tbl-cap: "Written as latex, in a longtable: the case that crashed"
#| echo: false
knitr::kable(d, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE)
```

# 4. A longtable written by hand

```{=latex}
\begin{longtable}{lr}
\toprule
term & estimate \\
\midrule
(Intercept) & -1.5 \\
x & 2.0 \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}
```

End of document.
